maria_cs: Quick sync — Solstice Health (acct 6057) invoice #8345 autopay ran at 2026-03-24T08:20Z and failed. Gateway returned `do_not_honor` then `card_declined`. Customer says treasury hit an auth window and will wire. Recommend disabling further card retries and issuing wire instructions.

adeem_fin: please paste gateway responses & last4. we need PO and written confirmation before creating manual wire invoice.

maria_cs: last4 5599. Declines: `do_not_honor`, `card_declined`. Attempts at 08:20Z and 08:44Z. PO on file: PO-7740. Customer email: "Treasury had an auth window. We will wire today if you provide beneficiary details. Please disable card retries."

tom_billing: create manual invoice flagged payment_method=wire, disable auto-retries. waive standard late fee for this case. require SWIFT/MT103 when wire completes for reconciliation. Ticket created once done.

billing-bot: [automated] Payment log: invoice=8345 customer=SolsticeHealth attempts=2 status=failed gateway=stripe region=us-west-1

ryan_sales: sales requests priority restore of access. I'll nudge treasury and confirm ETA. Offer a one-time pay link only as fallback if treasury can't wire today.

adeem_fin: approved. Action: tom_billing to create manual-wire invoice and attach wire template via secure channel; maria_cs to capture customer's confirmation that treasury will include reference "Invoice 8345 / PO-7740" (eta 3h). Attach proof of wire for closing. escalate to finance lead if not resolved by EOD PST.

maria_cs: sending secure wire template now and asking for confirmation. will update thread when customer replies.

tom_billing: Ticket BILL-4729 created for manual-wire settlement invoice 8345."
